headline: Four o'clock inventories the dark.
body: The last bus has already been a rumour for an hour. Milk crates stack themselves in a loading bay that will not open until six. A clock in the station waiting room ticks as if it were being paid to.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: pre-dawn grey, one aircraft light moving south

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: gutter water still, a bicycle locked to nothing useful

pulses.label: Watch
pulses.value: 04:04 BST, the minute that refuses to hurry
